dataset.name: WANDS all 55 real tenants; quiet tenant 'Rugs' (2002 products); churn tenant 'Furniture' (16039 products, continuously rebuilt); burst pool = remaining 54 tenants (Zipfian-weighted)

engine_config.native: commerce_core::index::CatalogIndex, quiet tenant fixed, churn tenant Mutex<Arc<CatalogIndex>> hot-swapped with no sleep between rebuilds (H14/P7-E11 mechanism), 4 burst worker threads sampling the other 53 tenants + Furniture's live snapshot via shared WeightedIndex

headline_result.h17_status: CONFIRMED, with a self-caught methodology fix (3 runs -> 10 runs, min/max verdict -> median verdict)
headline_result.named_limitation: only one churn/quiet tenant pair and one burst configuration tested; mechanism (CPU/memory-bandwidth contention widening the rebuild's disruptive window) is a plausible hypothesis, not independently confirmed via profiling; does not combine with H15 (shared-Solr contention)
